triggers.name: normalize_inventory
triggers.comment: Normalize display code — retain trigger intent
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER normalize_inventory BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF code ON sales.inventory FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sales.normalize_inventory()

functions.name: echo_text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.echo_text(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$ SELECT value $function$

functions.name: normalize_inventory
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales.normalize_inventory()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 NEW.normalized := upper(NEW.code);
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

functions.name: price_span

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales.price_span(numeric, numeric)
 RETURNS sales.price_span
 LANGUAGE internal
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$range_constructor2$function$

functions.name: price_span

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales.price_span(numeric, numeric, text)
 RETURNS sales.price_span
 LANGUAGE internal
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$range_constructor3$function$

relations.name: recent_events
relations.view:
SELECT at,
    payload
   FROM events
  WHERE (at > (now() - '1 day'::interval));

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inventory_pkey ON sales.inventory USING btree (code)

relations.name: inventory_totals
relations.view:
SELECT count(*) AS total
   FROM sales.inventory;

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inventory_totals_unique ON sales.inventory_totals USING btree (total)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_lines_pkey ON sales.order_lines USING btree (order_id, line_no)

constraints.name: order_lines_order_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES sales.orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX paid_orders ON sales.orders USING btree (created_at DESC) WHERE (state = 'paid'::sales.order_state)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_external_id_key ON sales.orders USING btree (external_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON sales.orders USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX row_encodings_pkey ON sales.row_encodings USING btree (id)
